review.note: Spell-tech pillar of Elysian: Source (mana-like) is the power type. Sourcelinks generate it, source jars and relays store and move it, and the enchanting apparatus, scribes table and imbuement chamber craft with it. Glyphs and rituals are the spell and ritual items. Archwood and sourcestone are building blocks. Familiars and starbuncles are the automation helpers. Supported by 22 mods (Ars add-ons, Create, Ex Deorum, Productive Bees and others). Sourcelinks are the 'magic generator' Elysian needs in place of tech power.
